name: fizzsum
prompt: Write fizz.py. Running `python3 fizz.py N` prints the FizzBuzz sequence for 1..N, one item per line (multiples of 3 print Fizz, multiples of 5 print Buzz, multiples of both print FizzBuzz, other numbers print themselves), and then a last line `Sum: S` where S is the sum of the numbers 1..N. Without an argument, N is 15.
